sloka: प्रमदाविग्रहं कृत्वा भरद्वाजाश्रमे ऽवदन् ।सुरा: सुरापा: पिबत पायसं च बुभुक्षिता: ।मांसानि च सुमेध्यानि भक्ष्यन्तां यावदिच्छथ ॥ २.९१.५१॥
transliteration: pramadāvigrahaṁ kṛtvā bharadvājāśrame 'vadan ।surā: surāpā: pibata pāyasaṁ ca bubhukṣitā: ।māṁsāni ca sumedhyāni bhakṣyantāṁ yāvadicchatha ॥ 2.91.51॥

translations.english: Asohka, emblic myrobalan and all other trees found in the forest malati, mallika and jati creepers assumed the form of women, came over to the hermitage of Bharadwaja and said:
